summary: Tested Fiverr Niche Arbitrage Scout backend (16 pytest tests) and frontend (login + dashboard + scan flow). 16/16 backend tests PASSED including auth, scrape job lifecycle (running->complete via background task, ~5-15s), opportunity_score schema (breakdown.demand/competition/saturation_gap, ratio, ratio_is_gold, metrics, 20 gigs, tags, data_source='simulated_fallback'), CSV+JSON export with proper Content-Disposition headers, watchlist CRUD with latest_snapshot, trends snapshots, and Gemini 3 Flash AI endpoints (/ai/expand returns expansions[], /ai/summarize returns bullets+verdict, /ai/pivots returns pivots[]). Frontend: login with demo creds works, dashboard renders with HISTORY sidebar showing prior scans (scores 60/73), WATCHLIST section visible, search input + SCAN button work (history sidebar populated after scan).

issues: Success toast 'Welcome back.' partially overlaps user email / SIGN OUT text in header (z-index/positioning collision)

action_items: Optional: adjust toast position so it doesn't overlap the header user email/sign-out link
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown') — migrate to FastAPI lifespan context manager
_run_scrape catches broad Exception; consider narrower handling and structured error logging
/api/scrape/jobs returns docs that include 'result' (minus gigs/tags) — payload size is fine but consider explicit field projection
scraper.deep_scrape() try/except wraps asyncio.wait_for swallowing genuine bugs silently; log the exception
seed_data_creation: Demo user + 2 scrape jobs (logo design minimalist, minimalist logo design) + trend snapshots created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All backend endpoints verified. Scrape uses simulated_fallback (Fiverr blocks datacenter IPs — expected). Gemini 3 Flash real integration works. For watchlist week_over_week_pct to be non-null, run /api/scrape/search twice for same keyword.
